outcome: Augmentation of labor with intravenous oxytocin
finding: Midwifery-led care in a birth center setting is associated with a decrease in medical interventions during labor, including lower rates of cesarean section and episiotomy.
mod_finding: Women receiving midwifery-led care in a birth center setting had lower rates of emergency cesarean sections, augmentation of labor with intravenous oxytocin, episiotomy, and operative deliveries compared to those receiving doctor-led care in a traditional delivery room.
